summary: Adds a 'Bank Fees' billable category (bank_fees, at cost, default on the invoice, no activity source) to Still Creek Ranch's active contract rate card for Bedrock-to-community billing. One contract_reimbursables row; nothing else changes.

preflight.name: Still Creek Ranch has exactly one active contract
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM contracts WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND status = 'active'

preflight.name: that contract has no bank_fees category yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM contract_reimbursables r JOIN contracts c ON c.id = r.contract_id WHERE c.community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND r.category = 'bank_fees'

expected_changes: Inserts one contract_reimbursables row on Still Creek Ranch's active contract: category bank_fees, description 'Bank Fees', billing_method at_cost, unit_price NULL, sort_order 60, default_on_invoice true.
No other contract, invoice or accounting row changes.

verify.name: Still Creek's active contract has exactly one Bank Fees category, at cost, on the invoice by default
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM contract_reimbursables r JOIN contracts c ON c.id = r.contract_id WHERE c.community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND c.status = 'active' AND r.category = 'bank_fees' AND r.description = 'Bank Fees' AND r.billing_method = 'at_cost' AND r.unit_price IS NULL AND r.default_on_invoice

verify.name: no other community gained a bank_fees category
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM contract_reimbursables r JOIN contracts c ON c.id = r.contract_id WHERE r.category = 'bank_fees' AND c.community_id <> 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006'
